description.description: Detailed description of the achievement in complete sentences without referencing the impact rating
description.title: Description

impact_reason.description: Brief reason for the impact rating (max 120 characters), explaining which organizational level was impacted
impact_reason.title: Impact Reason

impact_score.description: Impact rating from 1 to 10, where 1-3 is individual level, 4-6 is section level, 7-8 is wing level, 9-10 is HQ strategic level
impact_score.title: Impact Score

vision_verification.description: If vision data confirms this achievement, set to 'supported'. If vision data contradicts it, set to 'contradicted'. If NO vision data appears in your prompt or it does not exist for the specific achievement, set the key to 'none'
vision_verification.title: Vision Verification
